super.name: Super Lyan
super.budget: One cocktail. Selected Super Hours drinks are €6, 17:00–18:00; confirm the offer for your visit.
super.note: Walk-ins for five. Arrive at 17:00 for the early offer and the best chance of sitting together.
super.description: Hotel-bar craft with neon, colour and a much more casual mood. The best-value way into this shortlist if everyone can make an early start.
photos: The neon-lit bar at Super Lyan
A tall cocktail from Super Lyan’s gallery

janine.name: Janine
janine.budget: Estimated food budget; pizzas listed from €16, main dishes around €26–32. Dinner drinks extra.
janine.note: Reserve a table for five in the restaurant, rather than the daytime bakery.
janine.description: Wood-fired pizza, pasta and a warm dining room behind the bakery. Easy to keep affordable with pizza, or make it a longer dinner with shared starters.
photos: Pizza coming out of Janine’s wood-fired oven

oldenhof.name: Bar Oldenhof
oldenhof.budget: Published classics and signatures; premium spirit upgrades cost more.
oldenhof.note: Walk-in only for five. Meet at opening; keep a little flexibility before dinner.
oldenhof.description: Dark wood, intimate seating and carefully made classics: the closest alternative here to the cosy, dressed-up feeling of Fitz’s.
photos: The warm wooden bar at Oldenhof

stacks.name: Stacks Diner
stacks.budget: Estimated food budget for a main and a side or something shared. Dinner drinks extra.
stacks.note: A few reservations each night, plus walk-ins. Try to reserve five before committing to this route.
stacks.description: A proper sit-down evening with American homestyle food and an easygoing atmosphere. This is the requested Stacks Diner, not Stacks Deli.
photos: A window table at Stacks Diner
Fried chicken and a drink at Stacks

dutch.name: Dutch Courage
dutch.budget: Published signature cocktail range; a genever alone is cheaper but is not a cocktail.
dutch.note: Use the bar’s reservation link to check seating for five.
dutch.description: A warm, characterful bar built around Dutch spirits. Less ceremonious than the grand hotel bars, with plenty for curious cocktail drinkers.
photos: A cocktail served at Dutch Courage

bird.name: Bird Thai Restaurant
bird.budget: Estimated food budget for a main and shared starter; dinner drinks extra. Delivery prices are only a rough cross-check.
bird.note: No reservations. A table for five may mean a wait. Choose the sit-down restaurant at 72–74, not the snackbar at 77.
bird.description: An informal, lively dining room for fragrant curries and generous plates. Best for a group that values good food over a polished dining-room production.
photos: A candlelit table at Bird Thai Restaurant
A curry and rice from Bird’s official gallery

vault.name: Vault Bar
vault.budget: Planning allowance, not a verified menu quote. The official online cocktail menu does not publish prices.
vault.note: Check a reservation for five. Enter through the Waldorf Astoria hotel.
vault.description: Keep your original inspiration as the splurge option: intimate hotel surroundings and elaborate cocktails, followed by a much more relaxed dinner.
photos: Cocktail service at the Waldorf Astoria’s Vault Bar
A cocktail from Vault Bar’s official gallery

tujuh.name: Tujuh Maret
tujuh.budget: Nasi rames €27; Minahasa rijsttafel €39.50 per person, minimum two. Dinner drinks extra.
tujuh.note: Reserve for five; choose à la carte if the group prefers individual mains.
tujuh.description: A welcoming Indonesian restaurant with satay, rendang and plenty to share. Rijsttafel arrives as dishes for the table, rather than a long tasting-menu procession.
photos: A spread of Indonesian dishes at Tujuh Maret

pairs.label: The easy favourite
pairs.title: Bright drinks. Wood-fired dinner.
pairs.reason: The most effortless plan for five: a playful cocktail bar, a very short stroll, and a restaurant that lets everyone choose their own level of spend. Start early to unlock the €6 drinks.
pairs.tradeoff: The early offer makes the value case. After 18:00, budget €41–62 for a regular cocktail and food. The bar is walk-in, so seating together is not guaranteed.
pairs.drinkCaption: Super Lyan cocktail photo; the exact early-offer serve is not identified.
pairs.pairing: Start with ginger, lime and rum, then go for a tomato-based pizza. A fresh, easygoing flavour progression; choose a new drink with dinner.
pairs.orderNote: Dark ’n Stormy is listed in Super Hours; pizza is listed from €16.

pairs.label: The relaxed one
pairs.title: Dutch spirits. Thai spice.
pairs.reason: A characterful cocktail stop and a genuinely casual dinner on the same street. A strong choice when the group wants good drinks and flavourful food without dressing up the whole evening.
pairs.tradeoff: Bird does not take reservations. For five, a Friday queue is the main compromise; go early and allow waiting time.
pairs.drinkCaption: Dutch Courage’s cocktail photograph; not confirmed as Koko Klapa.
pairs.dishCaption: Curry and rice photographed by Bird; exact preparation may vary.
pairs.pairing: Coconut, passionfruit and lime at the bar lead naturally into a coconut-based curry. If heat divides the group, ask for milder dishes to share.
pairs.orderNote: Koko Klapa is listed at €16.50. Bird lists chicken and vegetarian curries.

pairs.label: The cosy one
pairs.title: Low lights. Comfort food.
pairs.reason: The strongest atmosphere match to Fitz’s, with the restaurant you already wanted. An unhurried drink in a beautiful old-school room, then a satisfying, unfussy dinner.
pairs.tradeoff: Stacks is just outside Centrum. The longer stroll still fits the 20-minute brief, but this is less convenient in wet weather. Oldenhof is walk-in for five.
pairs.drinkCaption: Oldenhof’s short-cocktail photo; the exact recipe is not identified.
pairs.dishCaption: Fried chicken at Stacks; presentation and sides may change.
pairs.pairing: A whiskey-led classic sets up the rich, savoury comfort of fried chicken. Order sides for the middle of the table and keep space for something sweet.
pairs.orderNote: Old Fashioned is on the current Oldenhof menu. Stacks lists fried chicken and seasonal sides.

pairs.label: The little splurge
pairs.title: A grand beginning. A shared table.
pairs.reason: Spend on the bar you already like, then keep dinner warm and sociable. The short walk and shareable Indonesian food make the contrast work particularly well for five.
pairs.tradeoff: The priciest bar on the shortlist. Its cocktail prices need confirmation, so the total is a planning allowance. Choose nasi rames or à la carte for a simpler dinner.
pairs.drinkCaption: Vault Bar’s cocktail photography; not confirmed as Amber Diamond.
pairs.dishCaption: Tujuh Maret’s rijsttafel; the current selection can vary.
pairs.pairing: Coconut rum and mango at the bar, then the coconut, spice and savoury flavours of an Indonesian spread. For a smaller meal, switch to nasi rames.
pairs.orderNote: Amber Diamond is on Vault’s signature list. Minahasa rijsttafel is €39.50 per person.
